# Grub Street

> > New York Magazine's food and restaurant publication covering NYC dining, restaurant openings, chef profiles, and culinary trends across Manhattan, Brooklyn, and beyond.

Grub Street is the premier source for New York City restaurant news, reviews, and food culture. The publication features the popular Grub Street Diet series, investigative food journalism, and comprehensive coverage of NYC's evolving dining scene from fine dining to viral food trends.

## Key Topics

- NYC restaurants
- Restaurant openings
- Fine dining
- Grub Street Diet
- Brooklyn dining
- Williamsburg
- Manhattan
- Chef profiles
- Food trends
- Restaurant reviews
- East Village
- West Village
- TikTok viral foods
- Culinary culture
- New York dining scene

## Restaurant Openings & News

- [Michelin-Starred Saga Will Reopen With a New Look](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/saga-reopening-charlie-mitchell-nyc.html): Michelin-starred Saga reopens with chef Charlie Mitchell and redesign
- [Ugly Baby Reopening in NYC](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/ugly-baby-reopening-nyc.html): Thai restaurant Ugly Baby to reopen in Williamsburg after 2024 closure
- [Eleven Madison Park Vet Opens Third Falcon in Fort Greene](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/third-falcon-opens-in-fort-greene-brooklyn.html): Chef Cali Faulkner's Breton restaurant Third Falcon opens in Brooklyn
- [A Stunning New Matcha Café, 12, Opens in NYC](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/12-matcha-cafe-nyc.html): Premium matcha cafe 12 opens in Noho with Hotta family sourcing
- [Siberia, a Legendary NYC Dive Bar, Reopens](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/siberia-bar-reopens-nyc.html): Hell's Kitchen dive bar Siberia reopens in Columbus Circle subway station
- [Chef Eddie Huang Opens Gazebo in NYC](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/eddie-huang-opens-gazebo-nyc.html): Eddie Huang's Mediterranean-Chinese pop-up Gazebo opens Lower East Side
- [Cugine Opens Casa Cugine in Williamsburg, Brooklyn](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/casa-cugine-sandwiches-williamsburg-brooklyn-opening.html): TikTok creator Cugine opens Italian-American sandwich shop in Brooklyn
- [A New Lawsuit Has Been Filed in the Ongoing Nom Wah Saga](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/nom-wah-tea-parlor-new-lawsuit.html): Chinatown's Nom Wah Tea Parlor cousins Vincent and Wilson Tang in lawsuit

## Restaurant Reviews & Guides

- [The Best New Restaurants in NYC, Mapped](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/new-york-magazine-where-to-eat-picks-mapped.html): Interactive map of New York Magazine's monthly restaurant picks
- [Restaurant Review: Kiko in Hudson Square](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/kiko-hudson-square-nyc-review.html): Matthew Schneier reviews Japanese fusion canteen Kiko in Hudson Square
- [Three New NYC Jazz Clubs](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/best-new-jazz-clubs-nyc.html): Guide to three new NYC jazz venues including Birds in Greenwich Village

## Food Trends & Culture

- [Dry-Aged Seafood Takes Off in NYC Restaurants](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/dry-aged-seafood-nyc.html): NYC culinary trend report on dry-aged fish replacing steak
- [How Protein Muscled Its Way Into American Grocery](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/high-protein-diet-food-grocery-stores.html): Investigation of high-protein food trend dominating American grocery stores
- [Five Viral Foods That Are Actually Good](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/five-viral-foods-that-are-actually-good.html): Underground Gourmet tests Instagram and TikTok viral food trends
- [How the Crunchwrap Became Bigger Than Taco Bell](https://www.grubstreet.com/article/crunchwrap-supreme-turns-20.html): 20-year history of Taco Bell's Crunchwrap Supreme and chef adaptations

## Grub Street Diet
